test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: A and B together can finish a job in 20 days. B and C together can finish the same job in 30 days. If A and C together can finish it in 24 days, in how many days can A alone finish the job?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B = 20 days

B and C = 30 days

A and C = 24 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Total work / Days

**Calculation:**

LCM of 20, 30, and 24 = 120 units

Efficiency of A and B = 120 / 20 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of B and C = 120 / 30 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of A and C = 120 / 24 = 5 units/day

Adding all efficiencies:

(A + B) + (B + C) + (A + C) = 6 + 4 + 5

2(A + B + C) = 15

A + B + C = 15 / 2 = 7.5 units/day

Efficiency of A = (A + B + C) - (B + C)

Efficiency of A = 7.5 - 4 = 3.5 units/day

Days taken by A alone = Total work / Efficiency of A

Days taken by A alone = 120 / 3.5

Days taken by A alone = 1200 / 35

Days taken by A alone = 240 / 7

Days taken by A alone = 34 ²/₇ days

**∴ A alone can finish the job in 34 ²/₇ days.**
